items.title: Cursor pulls a trojanized Claude Code 2.1.313 extension from its marketplace; up to 5,000 users hit
items.summary: A modified Anthropic.claude-code 2.1.313 (not built by Anthropic) sat in Cursor's IDE extension marketplace from about 2:27 AM to 1:35 PM PT on Oct 29, for Apple Silicon macOS and Windows x64. On load it collects host details, adds an attacker SSH key labelled svc-telemetry to authorized_keys, sets up a LaunchAgent or scheduled task for a reverse SSH tunnel and beacons to a server now taken down. Cursor took the marketplace down, rebuilt it and published a check command, IOCs and remediation scripts. Update to 2.1.314; uninstalling alone may not remove the persistence.

doubt.pushback: Early reports (The Hacker News, Phorion) called it the official extension or an Open VSX build; Cursor says it was a modified copy in its own marketplace and Socket found no 2.1.313 on Open VSX or npm.

items.title: Kimi adds 3D Make: Kimi drives Blender and CAD tools to build models, scenes and games
items.summary: Kimi now connects to Blender and CAD tools to create 3D models, assemble scenes and build games, available on kimi.ai and in Kimi Work. Replies are mostly curious; a few say it did not work for them or was not available to try yet.

doubt.pushback: A few repliers report it failing or not yet available on their accounts.

items.title: OpenBMB open-sources ForgeKernel after its agent beat FlashMLA prefill by 9.8% on B200
items.summary: The 22-hour live run ended with version 31 at 472 vs 518 microseconds on DeepSeek V4.1 FlashMLA prefill, without the agent seeing FlashMLA's source. OpenBMB is releasing the optimized fused prefill kernel, the kernels from its ForgeKernel paper (matching or beating 18 of 22 expert-library kernels) and the optimization harness.

items.title: OpenTTD-Bench: frontier agents run rival transport companies in real time; none beat the scripted AI yet
items.summary: Four agents share one seeded OpenTTD 15.3 game for ten game years (about 3 real hours) and are scored on operating profit through a Python client. GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra lead but still trail the AAAHogEx rules-based baseline; the writeup covers failure modes and how agents use subagents under time pressure. Code is open, built on Prime Intellect verifiers.

items.title: Letta FrontierMemory v1.1: bigger 750-trajectory corpus; Opus 5.5 still leads, open models close behind
items.summary: The memory benchmark update uses a larger, more balanced corpus meant to cut reward hacking. Claude Opus 5.5 remains top, with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3 close behind.

items.title: Pika releases H3 Flex open weights: six-step video with synced audio on MiniMax-H3
items.summary: Pika H3 Flex ships as two LoRA adapters (text/frame and multi-reference) on the MiniMax-H3 base, generating 5 to 15 s of 480p or 768p video with stereo audio in six steps. Day-0 Diffusers and ComfyUI support; tested locally on an H100 80GB, with 1080p to 4K through Pika's paid API.

items.title: bricky 0.1: a LEGO model compiler for coding agents, with CLI, MCP server and skill
items.summary: An agent writes a Python build script that places parts by BrickLink id; bricky checks the geometry, reports each mistake with the script line behind it and renders four views. Apache-2.0 on PyPI, with an MCP server (bricky-mcp) and a benchmark in the repo.

security_forwarded.matched: Cursor (IDE) and Claude Code in stack; always_forward agent tooling and software supply chain.
security_forwarded.why: Trojanized Anthropic.claude-code 2.1.313 (darwin-arm64, win32-x64) in Cursor's IDE marketplace Oct 29 2:27 AM to 1:35 PM PT. Plants svc-telemetry SSH key, LaunchAgent com.apple.sysmond (macOS) or SysMon task (Windows), ~/.config/.smt and .smtk, reverse tunnel to 134[.]209[.]82[.]225. Fixed by 2.1.314 plus the remediation script; uninstall alone is not enough. Rotate credentials reachable from any hit host. Box (Linux) not exposed: no Cursor IDE extensions, no claude-code extension, no svc-telemetry key, no .smt files, no tunnel processes. Bouncer: check Mini, Air and Pro (Apple Silicon Macs) for the extension version, the key, the LaunchAgent and .smt files; check csdesktop if it is Windows with Cursor. IOCs saved at /workspace/security/refs/IOC-cursor-claude-code-ext-2026-10-30.md. Seen via https://x.com/cursor_ai/status/2116074289053175808.

CVE-2026-98432 IPv4 TCP SYN-handling use-after-free; Anthropic demonstrated remote root against an exposed MPTCP listener, though the bug sits in the plain TCP path. Fixed in 6.12.113, 6.18.56, 7.2.10 and other stable lines; many distro builds still pending. Go 1.24+ programs open MPTCP listeners by default (GODEBUG=multipathtcp=0 is a fragile stopgap). Box kernel 6.12.94+ is below the fix and net.mptcp.enabled=1, but no MPTCP sockets are open; box kernel is managed by the host, so it can't be patched from here. Bouncer: check Spark and any Linux host for kernel version, internet-facing listeners and Go services with MPTCP. Seen via https://x.com/infrastack_ai/status/2116010536580341805; confirmed by oss-security 2026-10-30 and the Debian tracker.
